title: VERIFY: Complete user data isolation between accounts
description: Browser verification - test that two different users have completely separate data, even on the same browser.

acceptanceCriteria.text: User A signs up and practices songs, marks words learned
User B signs up on SAME browser (different email)
User B sees EMPTY dashboard - no User A data
User B practices different songs, marks different words
User A sees ONLY their own data - not User B's data
Leaderboard shows both users with their respective stats
Verify in Convex dashboard: data is properly separated by userId

notes:
BROWSER VERIFICATION REQUIRED - THIS IS THE CRITICAL TEST.

This verifies the security fix is complete:
1. Before fix: Same browser = same visitorId = shared data (BUG)
2. After fix: Each user has their own userId = isolated data (SECURE)

Test emails:
- User A: yosef.from.levant@proton.me
- User B: another test email or use + addressing (e.g., yosef.from.levant+test2@proton.me)

Before testing:
1. Delete both test users from Convex dashboard
2. Clear localStorage completely

This is the same test as V-011 but with the new secure implementation.
